title: Senior Technical Sourcer

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex
Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

What you’ll do
As a Senior Technical Sourcer, you will be a strategic talent partner responsible for identifying, engaging, and building pipelines of world-class technical talent. You’ll collaborate closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and technical leaders to deeply understand role requirements and develop proactive sourcing strategies that fuel both immediate hiring needs and long-term growth.

You’ll also play a key role in strengthening our diversity sourcing strategies and continuously improving sourcing processes and tools.

Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

• Lead end-to-end sourcing strategies for technical roles across engineering, data, product, AI, and other specialized functions.

• Conduct market research, competitive intelligence, and talent mapping to inform hiring strategies and pipeline development.

• Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through creative outreach across platforms such as LinkedIn, GitHub, and other talent networks.

• Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to align on candidate profiles, calibrate talent, and refine search strategies.

• Build and nurture long-term talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles, including future-facing skill sets.

• Champion diversity sourcing initiatives to attract underrepresented technical talent.

• Track, analyze, and report on sourcing metrics to continuously optimize outreach effectiveness and pipeline health.

• Maintain accurate candidate data and activity tracking within recruiting systems and dashboards.

• Contribute to process improvements, sourcing best practices, and knowledge sharing within the recruiting team.

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
SAP FI/CO Professional (m/f/d) OneFinance (Remote work, DE)
description:
The SAP FI/CO Professional will play a key role in supporting the Körber OneFinance transformation program. This role combines hands‑on SAP S/4HANA expertise with strong process knowledge across Finance, Controlling, and integrated logistics and sales processes. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in SAP FI/CO within S/4HANA environments, an excellent understanding of core accounting processes, and the ability to provide expert support throughout the rollout and post-go‑live stabilization.
Acting as a backfill within the project organization, this position ensures operational continuity while contributing to the successful deployment of S/4HANA across the Körber Group.
Your role in our team
S/4HANA Implementation & Support

• You provide hands‑on expertise in SAP FI/CO during the S/4HANA rollout, supporting fit‑gap analyses, testing activities, data validation, and cutover preparation

• You ensure that financial processes in the new system reflect business requirements and adhere to internal and external compliance standards

• You take ownership of post-go‑live support, including resolving incidents, optimizing processes, and stabilizing the financial landscape after deployment

Process Expertise Across Finance & Logistics

• You bring deep knowledge of end‑to‑end accounting processes such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Asset Accounting, and Financial Closing

• You support controlling‑related processes (e.g., cost center accounting, internal orders, basic profitability analysis) and collaborate with CO experts as needed

• You understand key touchpoints between Finance and logistics processes (FI/MM integration for procurement, FI/SD/CO integration for order‑to‑cash) and help ensure seamless E2E process flows

Cross ‑ Functional Collaboration

• As an interface between Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you ensure clear communication and alignment during design, testing, and rollout

• You support business users with training, documentation, and day‑to‑day issue resolution

• You collaborate with workstreams to address process dependencies and coordinate integrations across modules (MM, SD, CO)

Operational Backfill & Business Continuity

• You temporarily take over operational FI/CO tasks to free up internal experts for project activities

• You ensure stable daily operations throughout the S/4HANA transformation

• You help identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, or harmonization under the OneFinance/GBS framework

Your profile

• You hold a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Informatics, or a comparable field of study

• You bring hands‑on experience in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, ideally from project or transformational environments

• You have strong expertise in Finance processes (AP, AR, GL, Assets, closing) and good general knowledge of Controlling processes.

• You understand integrated logistics flows, ideally with experience in FI/MM and SD/FI/CO integration

• You are comfortable working in dynamic environments and managing multiple priorities during rollout phases

• With strong communication skills and cultural awareness, you collaborate effectively in international, cross‑functional teams

• You are fluent in English and German

• You bring an analytical, solution‑oriented mindset and enjoy working hands‑on with systems and data

• You are flexible with occasional business travel

• Experience in global or matrix organizations and familiarity with shared services (GBS) is beneficial

Your benefits

• Diverse opportunities to help shape the role and extensive options for training and development

• Flexible working hours and flat hierarchies in an international, modern work environment

• Mobile working within Germany as well as remote work abroad

• A work environment with room for initiative and clear ownership of your own topics and projects

• EGYM Wellpass and supplementary company health insurance to support personal well‑being

title: Customer Success Manager (North America)

With a proprietary approach to agentic AI, we have a unique opportunity to become the undisputed leader in our industry. We’re looking for excellent candidates to join our dedicated, thoughtful, and hardworking team to help us achieve that goal. We are a global company with offices in London, New York, and people across the world.
Our customers include some of the biggest names in retail including On, Rapha, Air Up, Holland & Barrett, AllSaints, Honeylove, and Clarins.
We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager who is excited by the opportunity of scaling an AI startup and is someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and working on interesting projects.
Role:
Customer Success at DG owns all post-sales customer engagement. This includes everything from scoping implementations, managing the delivery process, defining/achieving KPIs, ensuring continuous improvement post-implementation, generating case studies, and securing renewals.
This role will be responsible for the management and success of new and existing clients in the US and Canada. This role is open to candidates in both the US and Canada working East Coast business hours.

• Manage multiple projects in parallel for clients across all segments (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) and every phase of the post-sales customer lifecycle.

• Understand customer requirements necessary to scope projects effectively, implement our solutions successfully, and achieve KPIs to ensure customer referenceability, satisfaction, and retention.

• Work with Solution Engineers to ensure timely delivery and continuous improvement of implemented solutions.

• Responsible for generating case studies, securing renewals, and driving the growth of your client portfolio

• 2+ years client management experience in SaaS - background in CRM, API, and/or Customer Service spaces a plus.

Fast-track your career in technology consulting through one of Capco's flagship early careers programmes.

Our Next Generation Fellowship Programme is designed for exceptional recent or upcoming doctoral graduates who want to apply their research expertise to solving complex business and technology challenges.

Running for over ten years, the programme accelerates technically gifted individuals into consulting careers, providing opportunities to work alongside experienced consultants, former fellows, and industry experts on some of the most innovative transformation programmes in financial services.

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.
We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

In this role as a Case Management Coordinator, care management interventions focus on improving care coordination and reducing the fragmentation of the services the recipients of care often experience, especially when multiple health care providers and different care settings are involved. Taken collectively, care management interventions are intended to enhance client safety, well-being, and quality of life. These interventions carefully consider health care costs through the professional care manager's recommendations of cost-effective and efficient alternatives for care. description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

At Legora, security is the foundation of the trust our customers place in us. The world's leading law firms and largest corporations use our platform for their most sensitive matters. The risk of breach is very high, and we treat it that way.

We are building an engineering-led security function: secure defaults, paved roads, automation, and measurable risk reduction not advisory gates or ticket queues.

We need a Director of Security Engineering to set the direction for security across our product, platform, and cloud estate; build and lead the team; and tackle systemic problems rather than continually react to individual ones. You will work closely with engineering leadership to anticipate challenges, influence architecture and priorities, and make blockers and consequences clear.

This role can be based in Stockholm or New York. It is a 5-day in-office role we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.

Security strategy and architecture

- Define the security standard across Legora's product, platform, and customer commitments.

- Set the roadmap and investment priorities, looking ahead and identifying emerging risks and blockers early.

- Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership on architecture and technical direction.

Engineering enablement

- Build tools, paved paths, and secure defaults that help teams ship securely without friction.

- Embed security into the software lifecycle through reviews, standards, and automation.

- Drive areas such as secrets management, workload identity, and Kubernetes hardening through infrastructure as code.

Detection, response and agentic security

- Build automated detection and response, supported by specialist penetration testing.

- Own incident playbooks, exercises, and investigations.

- Threat-model our multi-tenant AI platform and define safe boundaries for coding agents.

Team and enterprise readiness

- Hire and develop senior security engineers across Application Security, Detection Engineering & Response, and Cloud & Platform Security.

- Give the team the direction and focus to solve underlying problem themes, not just individual findings.

- Support enterprise customers through security conversations, questionnaires, and evidence of our practices.

Who you are

- You have led and scaled a security engineering function through rapid product and team growth, ideally in an environment facing real threats.

- You have an engineering background rather than a purely corporate infosec or compliance background.

- You have strong architectural judgement and experience influencing technical direction at scale.

title: Synthesis or Formal Verification Developer at YosysHQ
description:
You might know YosysHQ from our many Open Source EDA Projects. We are the maintainers of Yosys and the accompanying Open Source EDA ecosystem. Our team is pushing the boundaries of EDA in interesting and unexpected ways, and making these tools and methodologies available for professionals, hobbyists and academics alike.
We offer off-the-shelf software packages that seamlessly integrate our tools in industry design environments and provide support and training for users of our software packages. We also offer custom development of individual features and entire flows based on our software components, and support and training for developers working on custom projects based on our Open Source work.
We are around 12 people, with two main focus areas: synthesis and formal verification. If you can contribute to either of these areas, we welcome your application.
Tasks
For the formal verification area:

• Our tools use C++, Rust, and Python. You should already be comfortable with either C++ or Rust, and willing to learn the others.

• Ideally, you would be familiar with the implementation side of hardware model checking.

• Alternatively, we think you would be able to succeed if you have a background in the general area of verification or formal methods (such as SAT/SMT solving, automated/interactive theorem proving, programming language theory or automata theory), and have had a little bit of contact with RTL hardware design.

For the synthesis area:

• You should be comfortable with C++.

• You should have some experience with RTL hardware design (ideally for ASIC).

• Any of the following experiences would likely transfer to this job:

• Building software for engineering or science applications

• Implementing a practical application based on an algorithm in the scientific literature

• Working on a compiler

As we are a small and busy team, we have limited resources for training. To succeed in this role you will need to have some experience in getting familiar with a large-ish pre-existing project. You’ll need to be comfortable taking responsibility for assigned tasks, working through them independently, and addressing challenges without needing extensive supervision.
Requirements
Important Notes
This is a flexible remote role which could be part time (1-5 days per week).
You would be working as an independent contractor/freelancer for an Austrian company, from wherever you are. Our team meetings usually take place between 3pm and 6pm Vienna time (CET/CEST), otherwise you can choose to work whenever you want.
YosysHQ has a flat pay hierarchy, where everyone earns the same rate: currently 6000€/month for full time contract work. As such, the only parameter that can be negotiated is the days per week.
As YosysHQ works with US government contractors, you must not be living in a country subject to sanctions or export restrictions, or banned from performing work for the US government for other reasons.
How to Apply:
Even if your background doesn’t perfectly align with these areas, we’re always interested in hearing from passionate and skilled individuals. If you’re intrigued by the work we do, please send us your CV and a brief cover letter detailing how your past experience translates to the work we do.
We’re especially excited to hear from candidates who have interacted with or contributed to our open-source tools-though this is not a requirement. Show us your potential, and let’s explore how you can make an impact!

You'll leverage your exceptional communication skills and industry knowledge to engage with small businesses, understand their challenges, and effectively communicate how the benefits of 401(k) for small businesses. • Qualification - Engage with prospects to understand their business needs, challenges, and goals. Qualify leads based on predetermined criteria to ensure alignment with our target market.

• Educate - Articulate the value proposition of our modern 401(k) solution to potential customers, highlighting how it can help business owners achieve their business objectives as well as help their employees save for retirement.

title: Strategy & Operations – Berufseinstieg / Intern (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Die meisten Einheiten in unserer Branche haben ihre Abläufe nie systematisch hinterfragt. Wer Kanzleien zukauft und in ein gemeinsames Setup überführt, sieht das in jeder einzelnen: gewachsene Prozesse, Werkzeuge aus drei Generationen, Wissen in Köpfen statt in Abläufen. Diese Rolle räumt das auf - Standort für Standort. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland - mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Darauf bauen wir die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand: organisch, durch Zukäufe und durch neue Standorte. Jede neue Einheit muss in ein gemeinsames Setup - und dieses Setup muss so gebaut sein, dass es beim doppelten Volumen nicht doppelt so viele Menschen braucht. Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor und willst operative Wirkung sehen - an Abläufen, an Werkzeugen und an Menschen. Du willst nicht in eine Konzern-Pyramide, in der du Konzepte schreibst, die drei Ebenen höher entschieden und dann nicht umgesetzt werden. Hier verantwortest du einen Ablauf von der Analyse bis zur Einführung am Standort, mit allen Widerständen, die dazugehören. Die Rolle hat zwei Zugänge. Als Praktikum über drei bis sechs Monate im fortgeschrittenen Studium - oder direkt als Berufseinstieg in Vollzeit. Der Zuschnitt ist derselbe, der Unterschied liegt im Horizont: im Praktikum verantwortest du einen Ablauf, im Berufseinstieg einen abgegrenzten Bereich. Du berichtest an die Operations-Leitung - solange diese im Aufbau ist, direkt an die Geschäftsführung - und arbeitest an allen Standorten. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in eine Manager-Rolle in Operations.

title: Logistics Area Manager
description:

Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře, ale lídra přímo do akce v provozu. V teto roli budeš mít přímý vliv na to, jak se nový sklad rozjede, jaká v něm bude kultura a jak hladce poběží každodenní logistika pro tisíce zákazníků.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Stavba od nuly: Dostaneš šanci rozjíždět nový projekt na zelené louce a zanechat na novém distribučním centru svůj přímý otisk.

- Skutečné vlastnictví: Budeš mít reálný dopad na denní provoz, efektivitu směny i spokojenost svého týmu.

- Akční prostředí: Nečeká tě stereotypní kancelářská práce - budeš přímo v centru dění moderní E-Commerce logistiky.

- Datově řízený provoz: Provoz řídíme na základě dat v reálném čase, takže budeš pracovat s moderními systémy a chytrými nástroji.

- Prostor pro vylepšení: Získáš samostatnost aktivně měnit a zefektivňovat procesy tam, kde uvidíš příležitost ke zlepšení.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Vedení týmu: Vedení, motivace a rozvoj týmu na směně, plánování kapacit, rozdělování práce a budování týmového ducha.

- Odpovědnost za výkon: Řízení směny s ohledem na klíčové ukazatele (KPIs) a plnění plánovaných cílů.

- Práce s daty: Sledování operativních čísel v reálném čase, vyhodnocování výkonu provozu a včasné reagování na odchylky.

- Optimalizace procesů: Identifikace úzkých hrdel na směně a aktivní navrhování i zavádění procesních vylepšení.

- Mezioddělená spolupráce: Úzká kooperace s ostatními vedoucími napříč skladem pro zajištění plynulého toku zboží.

- Směnný provoz: Práce v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden (12hodinové denní/noční směny).

Co od tebe očekáváme

- Lídrovské zkušenosti: Prokazatelnou praxi s vedením, řízením a motivací lidí v dynamickém prostředí.

- Jazykové vybavení: Aktivní angličtinu pro běžnou pracovní komunikaci a řešení operativních úkolů.

- Analytické a IT základy: Uživatelskou znalost práce na PC pro denní vyhodnocování dat a práci s interními logistickými systémy.

- Osobnostní předpoklady: Zodpovědný, spolehlivý a samostatný přístup s chutí rozvíjet sebe i svůj tým v rychlém tempu.

- Zkušenosti z logistiky: Předchozí praxe ze skladového nebo výrobního prostředí je výhodou, ne však absolutní podmínkou - klíčový je pro nás tvůj lídrovský přístup.

Co ti nabízíme

- Xtra membership: Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Dotované stravování: Dotované obědy, dobrá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti zdarma.

- Příspěvek na ošatné: 86 Kč ke každé odpracované směně.

- Odměny za pochvaly: Systém sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery (Alza, Notino atd.).

- Sport & relax: Příspěvek na karta MultiSport pro sport i regeneraci.

- Volný čas: Placené volno pro potřebný odpočinek.

- Tým a kultura: Neformální prostředí, společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální firemní akce.

We are an award winning, Tiktok-first, influencer marketing agency and social media company, here to shake up stuffy, old-school agency practices.
We know that success on TikTok for brands depends on speed and efficiency.
We know that creators do their best work when we let them be the creatives.
We’ve operationalized the whole influencer marketing process so that we can help brands move at the speed of TikTok.
Now, we are looking for passionate industry disruptors who are ready to move as fast as we do.

This is a fully-remote position. We just want the best, wherever you are.
In this position, you will be part of a dynamic and fast-paced team that values impact, efficiency and independence. As a fully remote company, all of our team members are fully responsible for their roles and sphere of influence.
Our clients are respected brands. You must be comfortable engaging senior stakeholders (VP of Marketing, CMOs) at high-value clients, providing expert insights on the influencer marketing and social media trends, and clearly establishing our value-add to the brands.

Your Goals
You will start by receiving some leads from Popcorn Growth , and converting these clients with an entry level service (billing ~$50,000 over 6 months) that allows our clients to understand our unique proposition. Once you have built a network of clients, you are expected to source your own leads.

• You are extremely self-driven and loves challenges

Our Values

• We think before we understand, and then we implement.

• When to get involved and when to get out of the way.

• There are days we are motivated, there are days we are not motivated. Every day, we are disciplined.

• We trust each other because of transparency.

• We reward performance, not hours worked, not tenure.

● NOT going to micromanage. You are encouraged to ask: if this goes wrong, will it significantly affect the company/process/client? If not, make a decision and move on.

title: Analyst, Institutional Team
description:
Analyst, Institutional Team
Team: Institutional / Private Markets
Full-time , remote (United States)
Reports to: Director, Institutional Sales

About StartEngine:
StartEngine is one of the largest private-market investing platforms in the United States, giving investors access to private companies that were historically the exclusive domain of institutions. Our Institutional team sits at the center of that market - building relationships with funds, family offices, RIAs, and other professional allocators, and executing the transactions that move private shares between them.
The private secondary market has grown into a multi-billion-dollar asset class, and the intermediaries who can source both sides of a trade, price it credibly, and close it cleanly are the ones who win. That is the job.

About the Role:
As an Analyst on the Institutional team, you will be a foundational member of a small, high-ownership group. You will support and increasingly own the full lifecycle of institutional transactions in private company shares - from identifying and qualifying counterparties, through indication of interest, pricing discussion, and documentation, to close.
This is a commercial, client-facing seat, not a back-office one. You will spend your days on the phone and in inboxes with sophisticated institutional investors. Analysts who perform well here move quickly into coverage ownership of their own accounts and, over time, into Associate and senior deal roles.
You should want to be in the market. If you would rather build models in a quiet room, this is the wrong desk.

What You'll Do

• Deal execution and coverage

• Run institutional transactions end-to-end: match buyers and sellers of private company shares, coordinate pricing conversations, manage the documentation process, and drive trades to close.

• Build and maintain the order book - track live bids, offers, indicative pricing, and inventory across the companies we cover, and keep it accurate enough that the team can trade off it.

• Qualify counterparties and demand: understand what each institution actually wants (name, size, structure, price sensitivity) and surface the trades that clear.

• Prepare the materials that support a live process - company overviews, comparable trade data, pricing context, and transaction summaries for institutional counterparties.

• Coordinate across legal, compliance, and operations on transfer mechanics, ROFR and issuer consent processes, KYC/AML, and settlement, keeping all parties informed and the timeline honest.

• Maintain deal files and CRM records to a standard that survives an audit and lets anyone on the team pick up a live process cold.

• Institutional partnerships

• Support coverage of a defined set of institutional relationships: funds, family offices, RIAs, wealth platforms, and secondary buyers - running outreach cadence, follow-up, and meeting prep.

• Prepare and run first-touch outreach and onboarding for new institutional accounts, and manage the follow-through that turns a first conversation into a first trade.

• Build a working point of view on the private secondary market - who is buying, who is selling, where names are trading, and what is changing - and share it with the team and with clients.

• Own CRM hygiene and pipeline reporting for your coverage: activity, stage, probability, and next step, with no stale records.

• Represent StartEngine credibly and compliantly in written and verbal communication with institutional counterparties.

Must-haves:

• 1-3 years of full-time experience in investment banking, private equity or VC, secondaries advisory, private-market brokerage, capital markets, sales & trading, or an equivalent transactional finance role.
Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record, ideally in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related quantitative field.

• Working fluency with private-market mechanics: cap tables, preferred vs. common, SPVs and forwards, transfer restrictions, ROF

The Associate Director, Packaging Science will provide technical leadership for the development, qualification, specification, and continuous improvement of packaging systems used to safely and efficiently deliver fresh food to consumers.

This role sits at the intersection of packaging engineering, food safety, cold-chain management, product quality, logistics, operations, and supplier technical management. The position will establish and maintain packaging and distribution specifications that protect food quality and safety throughout the delivery network while balancing cost, sustainability, manufacturability, customer experience, and operational performance.

The Associate Director will serve as a technical authority for temperature-controlled food. 

 

You Will...

• Own the technical framework and specifications for packaging systems used to ship perishable food from fulfillment through the customer's doorstep.

• Establish and maintain packaging standards, technical specifications, drawings, performance requirements, qualification protocols, and acceptance criteria.

• Define and validate thermal requirements for insulated shippers, liners, refrigerants, and packaging configurations across seasonal, geographic, and worst-case conditions.

• Partner with Food Safety and Quality to prevent contamination, leakage, temperature excursions, product damage, tampering, and loss of product integrity.

• Lead the development and commercialization of innovative packaging solutions, including sustainable insulation, reduced-material systems, recyclable/reusable packaging, improved moisture management, leak resistance, and enhanced dimensional efficiency.

• Establish supplier technical requirements, qualification processes, performance expectations, scorecards, and change-control procedures.

• Partner with Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Procurement, Sustainability, R&D, and Customer Experience to translate technical requirements into scalable and practical solutions.

• Develop technical governance systems, including packaging risk assessments, distribution test standards, failure/RCA procedures, seasonal validation programs, and packaging performance dashboards.

• Drive continuous improvement by using performance, temperature, quality, operational, financial, and sustainability data to improve packaging reliability, cost, efficiency, and customer experience.

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer on the Sentry products team, you will work inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality and reliable products for Anduril's Sentry autonomous surveillance systems and the critical components that make successful sourcing solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, quality, and performance of components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's core commodity families - PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging - that enable Sentry to operate in demanding field environments. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers, and partnering with them for world-class results is essential across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing across multiple commodity types, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria and metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the Sentry product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's commodity families: PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product, part, and sub-assembly requirements.

• Provide technical expertise for manufacturing and outsourcing processes across commodities - including printed circuit board assemblies, structural and power systems, radar modules, and imaging sensor assemblies. Drive the gathering of data and insights from suppliers to conduct top-tier evaluations of manufacturability, quality, cost-efficiency, capability, and audit compliance.

• Partner with development engineering (mechanical, electrical, RF, and optical/systems), product quality engineering, and program management to deliver predictable supply to Sentry development programs and production programs, and manage exceptions, containments, and deviations for supplier technical performance.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings, schematics, and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems and inspection criteria, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, MSA, Audit, inspection development, PFMEA & AS9102, etc.).

• Partner with Category Management and Sourcing Engineering to drive overall supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and fulfillment of strategic goals across all four commodity families.

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the Sentry product lifecycle, from early prototyping through scaled production. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the technology/vendor capability roadmap and delivery schedules needed for future Sentry variants, proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and explorations.

• Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA)

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster, but we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. They intelligently lead projects through all phases of development, from research and pitching to delivery - acting as a skilled interface between client needs and production capabilities, ultimately working to ensure the success of all work they touch - whether delegating or directly completing.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO  

• Lead the creation of brand messaging and themes that succeed across mediums, formats, and campaign types with a focus on Direct Response writing.

title: Vehicle V&V Manager

What you will do:
As a Vehicle Test Manager, you will own the vehicle-level test strategy for our L4 autonomous trucks: writing test cases that verify requirements on closed courses and public roads, and post-processing vehicle data from ground truth and on-board systems to assess performance. You will lead a team of test engineers responsible for the verification of vehicle-level requirements using industry-standard vehicle test equipment and internally developed analysis tools. Your work is critical to closing Torc’s safety case and ensuring the product meets performance expectations.

• Define and implement the vehicle test strategy in accordance with relevant safety standards (e.g., ISO 26262, ISO 21448).

• Lead and mentor a team of test engineers responsible for vehicle-level test case development and reporting.

• Partner with systems engineering, software development, and test operations to establish vehicle verification and validation priorities.

• Ensure requirement verifiability.

• Drive scenario-based testing methods to scale coverage across the operational design domain.

• Ensure the suitability and continuous improvement of vehicle test platforms and toolchains.

• Manage test budgets, schedules, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent vehicle programs.

• Prioritize testing using upstream test results to surgically address risks.

• Communicate test status, risks, and recommendations to leadership to support program decisions.

• Represent the vehicle test organization in program reviews, safety case reviews, and regulatory or customer audits.

• Coordinate software tool qualification processes and stay current on emerging V&V technologies for autonomous driving.

What you’ll need to succeed:
Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field with 6+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with 4+ years of experience.

• Proven experience managing vehicle-level testing for safety-critical products.

• Demonstrated leadership experience building and developing technical teams.

• Working knowledge of quality, safety, and security standards (ASPICE, ISO 26262, ISO 21448, or equivalent).

• Experience with scenario-based verification and validation approaches for autonomous systems.

• Experience with industry-standard certification testing such as EuroNCAP.

• Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.

• Experience processing vehicle data collected with ground truth equipment (e.g., high-precision GNSS/INS, LiDAR reference systems) used in ADAS/AV testing.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Enthusiasm for tackling new challenges and applying state-of-the-art V&V approaches.

title: Product Manager

IT Support Engineer | USA

Employment: Full-Time Company Description

Twenty5 is an innovative software company specializing in bringing business value to project-centric industries, including Aerospace & Defense, Professional Services, and Capital Projects. By leveraging advances in predictive analysis and AI, Twenty5 optimizes pricing and cost estimation processes, making them more efficient and data-driven. By utilizing project knowledge and performance insights, we support businesses in delivering precise and effective project proposals with ease.

Role Description

We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Technical Support Engineer to join our US-based support team. Our product is a feature-rich enterprise application built on top of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Tomcat , running on Java, ExtJS, and JavaScript, with SAP HANA as the database backend.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting end users and enterprise clients during US business hours, diagnosing and resolving application and infrastructure issues, assisting with product installations and configuration, and collaborating closely with the engineering team to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.

This is a hands-on technical support role - not a DevOps or development position. You will be expected to learn the product deeply, understand its architecture, and become the go-to expert for troubleshooting across the full stack. We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to grow your skillset as our product evolves.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Support & Troubleshooting

• Serve as the primary technical support point of contact for US-based clients during business hours.

• Diagnose and resolve issues related to the application, including UI (ExtJS/JavaScript), backend (Java), and database (SAP HANA) layers.

• Triage incoming support tickets, reproduce issues in test environments, and drive resolution within SLA commitments.

• Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes of failures, performance bottlenecks, and configuration errors.

• Collaborate with the engineering and product teams to escalate bugs and complex technical issues with clear, detailed documentation.

2. Application Installation & Configuration

• Assist clients and internal teams with installation, deployment, and configuration of the application on SAP BTP.

• Support Docker-based deployments, including troubleshooting container startup, networking, and runtime issues.

• Configure and validate SSO/SAML-based authentication integrations between the application and client identity providers.

• Manage and validate BTP-specific configurations such as destinations, service bindings, and environment variables.

• Execute Shell scripts for environment setup, log collection, and routine maintenance tasks.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
OPSWAT , a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position
We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering - streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed - not another CRUD app behind a form.
You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide - in the best way.
AI-native. Non-negotiable. You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer - demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
What You'll Own
You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there - meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.
Who You Are

• You see what needs to exist and you go build it - you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.

• You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it - not because of a title.

• You own the entire arc - design, build, ship, operate - and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.

• When you hit the edge of what you know - a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen - curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.

• "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

• Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier - you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.

• 5-7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.

• Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.

• A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems - you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.

• Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

Identity is the foundation of trust in an AI-powered world. As people build a rich personal and organizational context in ChatGPT, they need systems that protect it, remember it, and let them share it securely across apps and agents. Our team builds the trusted OpenAI account layer that connects people, enterprises, developers, and agents to OpenAI apps and the broader AI ecosystem. - Have 10+ years of experience building, scaling, and operating distributed systems at large scale.

- Have 3+ years of experience managing high-performance engineering teams in fast-paced, rapidly shifting environments.

- Care deeply about people leadership, coaching, and helping engineers achieve peak performance.

- Communicate clearly, think holistically, and make decisions grounded in both user needs and long-term sustainability.

- Have experience managing an infrastructure team and are effective at hiring, coaching, and developing engineers while maintaining strong operational excellence.

- Have deep experience building and operating high-scale backend systems, with a track record of improving reliability, latency, and security in production.

- Bring broad infrastructure expertise across the stack-from hardware and cluster management to services and storage layers.

title: Product Manager, Developer Tools & Compiler
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

We are looking for a technical, detail-oriented Product Manager to own the product backlog for IonQ's developer tools and compiler. This includes our SDK, compilation and optimization toolchain, simulators, and integrations with popular quantum frameworks. You'll be part of IonQ's Compute Product Management team. You'll embed with the engineering teams that build these tools and help turn strategy into clear, prioritized, buildable work.

In this role, you'll be the day-to-day product partner for engineering. You'll translate developer and customer needs into well-defined requirements, set and defend priorities, write acceptance criteria that make "done" clear, and make sure what ships solves real user problems. You'll work closely with Engineering, Developer Experience, Applications Research, and Customer Success to shape how researchers and developers build on IonQ hardware.

You don't need a background in quantum computing. You DO need a strong technical foundation, real empathy for developers, and the discipline to turn ambiguous problems into precise, testable requirements. This role suits someone who is curious, comfortable in fast-moving technical discussions, and motivated by seeing their work show up in the tools developers use every day.

If you're passionate about developer tools and excited to help shape how the world programs quantum computers, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

• Prioritize the Backlog: Own and maintain a prioritized backlog of features, improvements and bug fixes. Weigh user impact, business value, technical effort and dependencies. Make clear tradeoff calls and explain the reasoning to engineering and stakeholders.

• Define Requirements & Acceptance Criteria: Turn user needs, customer feedback and roadmap goals into clear product requirements and user stories with actionable, defined goals. Work with engineering and QA to confirm what ships meets those goals.

• Understand the Technology: Learn IonQ's compiler, gate sets, simulation and SDK architecture well enough to take part in technical tradeoff discussions. Know where compiler performance, circuit fidelity and developer usability pull against each other.

• Partner with Engineering: Embed with the developer tools and compiler engineering teams as their primary product counterpart. Join sprint planning, backlog grooming, design reviews and standups. Be available to answer product questions quickly so the team keeps moving.

• Ship and Iterate: Shepherd features from definition through release. Coordinate release notes, documentation and enablement with Developer Experience. Measure adoption and quality after launch, and feed what you learn back into the backlog.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, a related techni

The Strategic Finance team partners across OpenAI to turn company strategy into financial decisions, help allocate resources, and steer the business toward its highest-impact long-term outcomes.

Within Strategic Finance, the B2B Product Finance team owns the financial perspective on growth across OpenAI’s B2B portfolio. We connect monetization and customer economics with compute demand, capacity, margin, and resource planning, partnering closely with Product, GTM, Strategic Deal Desk, Compute Finance, Capacity Planning, Data, Accounting, and other Finance teams.

About the Role

We are hiring a strategic finance partner to partner with Product and GTM leaders in incubating and launching new B2B Products. You will evaluate new product initiatives and commercial viability, help shape commercial strategy, develop forecasts and revenue targets, and build the 0→1 financial foundations and decision-making frameworks to scale these products. 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Support strategic initiatives and new product launches, including but not limited to: early opportunity sizing, pricing, packaging, and business development deal structuring to enhance product profitability.

- Deep dive into frameworks and process improvements to increase our sophistication in analyzing, forecasting, and optimizing product contribution margins and user lifetime value.

- Establish and manage key metrics underpinning product revenue,gross margin performance, and other leading indicators, and regularly monitor, analyze, and report on these metrics to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

- Stay updated on market trends and competitive dynamics to refine financial strategies.

- Create high-quality executive and Board-facing presentations.

- Collaborate with Accounting and FP&A teams to evolve financial forecasting and reporting processes.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 8+ years of experience in investment banking, consulting, or buy-side investing coupled with operational experience at a fast-paced, scaling company.

- Direct ownership of strategic finance, product finance, commercial finance, pricing and monetization, or product P&Ls in a complex B2B business.

- A track record of deep cross-functional partnership across Product, GTM, Data Science and the ability to influence senior leaders when incentives or priorities conflict.

- Expert modeling skills, including building detailed product P&Ls and operating models.

- The ability to distill complex financial data into actionable insights and effectively communicate with leadership.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to craft compelling narratives using data.

- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in financial reporting and analysis.

- Familiarity with business models and metrics relevant to OpenAI, including contribution margin analysis.

- Enthusiasm for technology and artificial intelligence.

- Experience with SQL and AI fluency, including experience using tools such as Codex to automate workflows, build analytical tools, and improve the speed and quality of financial analysis.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Hardware Systems Lead, Drone
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Hardware Systems Lead for our drone program, you will be the hands-on chief engineer for the hardware that carries our autonomy into the air. You will understand the full system, mechanical and electrical, and own the question that matters most in flight: will it survive, and will it keep working when the aircraft is hundreds of feet up? You will architect, build, test, and break hardware, then use what you learn to make it lighter, tougher, and more reliable. Your decisions will define how Applied's hardware performs in flight, in wind, vibration, shock, temperature swings, and moisture, and you will work closely with autonomy, software, and flight test teams to get aircraft flying.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Own the end-to-end hardware architecture, mechanical and electrical, for Applied Intuition’s drone platforms

- Be hands-on: prototype, build, integrate, debug, and test hardware on real aircraft, not just review designs

- Define and drive survivability: determine how sensors, compute, avionics, harnesses, connectors, and enclosures will hold up to vibration, shock, hard landings, thermal extremes, dust, water ingress, and EMI

- Lead integration of sensors (cameras, lidar, radar, GNSS/IMU), compute, power systems, communications, and flight controllers onto airframes

- Own size, weight, and power (SWaP) tradeoffs, balancing performance, flight time, payload capacity, and cost

- Define hardware requirements and reference architectures that scale across aircraft configurations

- Plan and run environmental, durability, and flight testing, analyze failures and crashes, and drive root cause and design fixes

- Be the technical authority and escalation point for hardware tradeoffs across mechanical, electrical, avionics, software, autonomy, and flight test

- Lead hardware design reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor other engineers

- Support flight test campaigns, demonstrations, and field operations

We’re looking for someone who:

- BS/MS in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field

- 10+ years of hands-on hardware engineering experience on drones, UAS, or other aircraft

- Strong command of the whole hardware system: airframe and structures, electrical architecture, power distribution, harness design, avionics, and how they interact

- A track record of designing hardware to survive demanding environments, with real experience in vibration, shock, ingress protection, thermal management, and EMI/EMC

title: Testing Architecture Specialist
description:
This opportunity is in Tampa - Santo Domingo - Remote (EST +/- 6)
﻿﻿
Position Overview
Conceived on the back of the 2017 crypto wave, our client was borne of a realization. While Infura enabled the ICO boom, it also made it extremely vulnerable due to operating as a single point of failure. A secure, efficient, and censorship-resistant future for Web3 must be enabled by truly decentralized infrastructure, not by centralized platforms gating access to networks.

The pitfalls of Web2 become more obvious by the day - security breaches, gatekeepers, and ever-more aggressive censorship have turned the open-source dream of the free internet into increasingly dystopian surveillance and control system. Our client offers a radical escape: a means to bring the free internet back, only this time it's unstoppable.

Their engineering department currently includes a small stable team specialists in critical areas, our CTO, and our CEO. They achieved a great deal, but they also understand that what got you here, wont get you there. They will be scaling up the engineering team in 2022 and they want to bring smart people aboard that will help make fulfill the goals and deliver the best platform while ensuring quality.
Thats where you come in: you will be in charge of everyday research, design, and development of new testing frameworks for the Blockchain Protocol to ensure quality and provide QA Guidelines across the team and the project. You will have to drive your progress and propose new ideas and solutions that will make the Protocol be faster, leaner, robust, and secure.

You will need to architect, design, and implement the tooling that will ensure the quality in an efficient, automated, and replicable way. You will also be an active participant in the protocol research and development effort, making sure that any feature or attribute of the system quality can be properly measured, assessed, and improved on.

You should also be an active member of the community, you will have to be a leader and role model for community developers that will join the project. You will have the opportunity to do research and present papers that will drive and motivate others to participate in the development of the Blockchain Protocol.

Success will be measured primarily in qualitative terms, which may include but are not limited to: participating in ideation meetings, bringing new ideas to the table and running research to find the best solutions, and implementing those ideas with quality in mind.

Key Projects & Objectives

• R&D

• On a daily basis, you will be running research, designing systems, and participating in ideation meetings to bring new solutions to the table

• Participate in other members Ideas, by discussing and proposing improvements

• Help another team member to run research and comparison about different options

• Write reports and papers about research results

• Accept suggestions, ideas and help with your research tasks

• Propose testing solutions and testing plans for every new aspect of the project

• Ensure that other team members provide options to ensure project quality from the ground up

• Implementation

• Create testing infrastructure to support development

• Describe testing strategies for every project goal

• Implement QA systems for every step of the development and deployment process using automated tools and automated pipelines

• Work side by side with the infrastructure specialist to implement automated testing tools down the pipeline

• Work side by side with Protocol Specialist to ideate features with testing and QA mindset first, ensure that everything is testable and accountable

• Review

• Code review implementations, comment and suggest improvements

• Help other team members to unblock their work

• Participate in projects by providing your best knowledge

• Review community contributions and help the community participation on the project

• Role model

• Participate in community channels, answer question

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description:
Cazoo , is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike! As a leader in the market, we pride ourselves on providing unparalleled search tools, expert car guides, insightful reviews, and a comprehensive vehicle price guide. Our mission is simple: to empower buyers to find their perfect car efficiently and with confidence, while also helping automotive retailers reach millions of eager buyers.
At Cazoo , you'll be part of a team that's revolutionising the way people buy and sell cars. If you're ready to drive your career forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, Cazoo is the place for you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of automotive retail!
We are looking for Principal Platform Engineer
Reports To: Director of Technology
Contract Type: Permanent
Location: Remote, UK based
About the role:
We're looking for a Principal Platform Engineer to help shape the next generation of Cazoo 's technology platform.
We're undertaking a significant modernisation of our existing Azure-based architecture, moving towards more scalable, cloud-native and event-driven services. This is an opportunity to influence how our core platform evolves, improve the experience of our engineering teams and build the foundations that support our customer-facing products.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role , combining software engineering, architecture and platform strategy. You'll spend around half your time actively contributing to engineering delivery, while also helping set technical direction, mentoring engineers and driving initiatives across teams.
You'll be responsible for:

• Driving platform modernisation: Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, event-driven services, including the safe retirement of legacy systems.

• Shaping technical direction: Own and deliver the roadmap for core platform capabilities, working with Engineering, Product and Commercial stakeholders to align priorities.

• Remaining hands-on: Write production code, review pull requests, solve complex technical problems and work directly alongside engineering teams.

• Improving developer experience: Build and evolve shared services, tooling and engineering practices that make it easier for our teams to deliver high-quality software.

• Championing engineering excellence: Improve scalability, reliability, observability and operational standards across our platform.

• Leading through collaboration: Work closely with architects, Principal Engineers and cross-functional squads to turn architectural vision into practical solutions.

• Developing our engineers: Mentor others, share knowledge and help establish consistent engineering standards across teams.

• Embracing AI-assisted engineering: Help establish effective practices and guardrails for using AI development tools to improve productivity without compromising quality or security.

You'll have genuine ownership and influence, with the opportunity to make meaningful architectural decisions while remaining close to the technology and people delivering them.
What we ideally looking for;
Extensive backend or platform engineering experience , gained building and operating high-traffic, business-critical systems, ideally within a product-led technology business.

• Strong cloud engineering expertise , preferably Azure, with a solid understanding of cloud-native architecture, managed services and infrastructure as code.

• Proficiency in a modern backend language , ideally TypeScript/Node.js, although we're open to experienced engineers with strong transferable backgrounds, such as Java.

• Experience with distributed and event-driven systems , including technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus.

• Solid understanding of platform technologies , including Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and observability tooling.

• Experience designing data-intensive services , working with relational and non-relational databases, caching and search technologies.
